title: Priya's Long Day
subtitle: Present simple: he/she/it con -s y do/does

content.instructions: Completa con el present simple del verbo entre paréntesis.

items.text: Priya ___ (be) a nurse. She ___ (work) at the hospital in Bristol, and she ___ (have) a very long day. She ___ (get up) at six o'clock, she ___ (have) a quick shower and she puts on her blue uniform. She is always sleepy in the morning.
items.hint: Con he, she e it el verbo lleva -s. Cuidado: have → has.

items.text: She ___ (not / eat) a big breakfast. She only ___ (drink) a cup of tea. Then she ___ (go) to the hospital by bus. The bus ___ (leave) at a quarter to seven.
items.hint: Negativa con he/she/it: doesn't + verbo sin -s. Go → goes.
items.explanation: Después de doesn't el verbo va en infinitivo: She doesn't eat (no «doesn't eats»).

items.text: At the hospital, Priya ___ (help) the doctors and she ___ (talk) to the patients. Her shift ___ (finish) at seven in the evening. "___ (you / like) your job?" Lucía asks. "Yes, I love it," Priya says.
items.hint: Los verbos que acaban en -sh, -ch, -s, -x llevan -es: finish → finishes.

items.text: Sam and Priya ___ (not / have) the same timetable. Sam ___ (work) at night and he ___ (sleep) in the morning. "When ___ (Sam / do) the washing-up?" Lucía asks. Priya ___ (laugh): "Never!"
items.hint: Pregunta con he/she/it: does + sujeto + verbo sin -s.

vocabulary.definition: a list of times when things happen
washing plates, cups and pans after a meal
special clothes that people wear for their job
